sections.label: NDP funpack cost and items
sections.summary: Questions asked about NDP funpack costs, essential items, produced items, excess items, and how National Day celebrations differ under COVID-19 measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Defence (a) what is the projected total cost of producing, packing and distributing the NDP funpacks to each citizen and PR household for NDP 2020; and (b) whether the Government will consider creating an option for those who would like to donate the expense required for their funpack back to the state or to charities.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Defence (a) whether essential and care items can be included in the NDP funpacks to enhance the relevance and usefulness of the funpacks during this challenging period; (b) what items in the NDP funpacks have already been produced for distribution; and (c) what happens to excess items not distributed or when households opt out of the funpacks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister how will Singapore's National Day commemoration and celebrations differ at the national and local levels in view of the COVID-19 measures.

sections.label: First National Day Parade 1966
sections.summary: The first NDP in 1966 was held in testing times, with 500,000 school children singing the national anthem.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The first National Day Parade (NDP) in 1966 was held amid the most testing of times.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: On the morning of 9 August 1966, 500,000 school children assembled in schools and sang the new national anthem, Majulah Singapura, Onward Singapore.

sections.label: NDP budget reduced by a third
sections.summary: Final cost figures are not in, but this year's NDP should reduce the usual budget by a third from infrastructure savings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The final cost figures are not yet in, but at very least, this year's NDP should be able to reduce the usual budget by a third, with savings from the cost of infrastructure that would have been built if we had held it in the usual way at the Padang or the Float @ Marina Bay.

sections.label: NDP through Singapore's troubled periods
sections.summary: Through troubled periods of Singapore's history, the National Day Parade did not falter, and Singapore emerged stronger; COVID-19 is the most severe global disruption in a century.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Indeed, through every troubled period of Singapore's history – whether it was the British withdrawal in 1971, the recession of 1985, the Asian Financial Crisis in 1998, SARS in 2003, the Global Financial Crisis in 2008, the H1N1 epidemic in 2009 – the drumbeat of the National Day Parade that Singaporeans marched to, neither faltered nor reduced in intensity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Because of that hope and optimism, Singapore emerged stronger.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It has been five months since COVID-19 struck our nation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It is, by any account, the most severe disruption globally for at least a century.

sections.label: NDP 2020 in every household
sections.summary: NDP 2020 will be celebrated in the safety and comfort of every household in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: NDP 2020 will be celebrated in the safety and comfort of every household in Singapore.

sections.label: Parade at the Padang
sections.summary: To remind Singaporeans of the founding spirit of the first NDP and face difficulties ahead, a parade should be held at the Padang.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: To remind us of that founding Singapore spirit of that first NDP and to gear Singapore up to face difficulties ahead, it is only right that a parade be held at the Padang.

sections.label: Singapore Together Pack contents and cost
sections.summary: The Exco decided to include hand sanitisers, thermometers, face masks, and a snack and drink, with each Singapore Together Pack costing around $2.40.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The Exco has decided to include hand sanitisers, thermometers, face masks – I think Miss Cheng asked about this – and a snack and drink from a local F&B company.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Mr Leon Perera asked about cost – the cost of each Singapore Together Pack will be around $2.40.

sections.label: Fewer Singapore Together Packs produced
sections.summary: The Exco will produce packs for about 80% of households, and those who want them can collect them from the CCs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: What the Exco can do this year is to produce fewer Singapore Together Packs, taking into account those who have said that they do not need one.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It will therefore produce packs for about 80% of households, which from prior experience should be adequate.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: All those who want them to celebrate our NDP together can collect them from the CCs.

sections.label: 80% production based on past experience
sections.summary: Past experience shows 80% will be enough, less than the usual 90% or 95% of households, accounting for those who said they do not need one.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Our past experiences show that 80% will be enough.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It is actually less than what we produce usually.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We produce usually about 90% of households, sometimes 95%, but we have taken into account those who said they do not need one.

sections.label: MPs may request more bags
sections.summary: MPs wanting to organise events near 9 August for their constituencies can ask for more bags, and more will be produced if possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: If Members of Parliament, judging by the conditions, want to organise events near 9 August for your constituencies and you want us to facilitate with more bags, let me know, and if we can, we will produce more.

sections.label: Common space and 80% funpacks
sections.summary: Asserting differences during National Day Parade will shrink common space, and 80% of funpacks are being produced for Singapore households.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: What you represent as Singapore does not show my narrower sets of preferences or who I am." If they choose to assert those differences during National Day Parade, it is what it is, it is what it will become, but it will shrink our common space.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: I do not know the details of the REACH survey.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One, I do understand we are producing 80% of funpacks for the Singapore households.

sections.label: Excess funpacks distribution plans
sections.summary: If there are excess bags, 80% is less than usual production, and there will be avenues to distribute them to homes or institutions so they are not wasted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: But many are asking what are we doing with the excess funpacks that are not collected.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: I do not know that there will be excess packs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Let us all hope, maybe come August – given the wonderful job that my colleagues at the Multi-Ministry Task Force have done and Singaporeans taking necessary precautions – that actually come August, there will be a mood to come out of this and people want these packs because they want to join in the celebrations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: But if they are excess bags, 80% is less than what we have usually produced – there will be no shortage of avenues to distribute to, say, to certain homes or institutions, so they would not be wasted.
